name: magentix
description: Adds the Magentix adoption engine to Claude Code: skills that survey a project or elicit a user profile, bind an agent harness, author a spec tree from a best-practice blueprint, validate and adopt a practice, and check it for drift afterward — plus two read-only subagents (profile-surveyor, spec-validator) that gather evidence and validate specs without editing anything. Everything here is a compiler from blueprints and profiles to real files at real paths; it ships no active hooks.
